source: onyx-1 indexer, the rollup's queries (slice 13a), recorded from the sandbox through its proxy

answers.what: the time of blocks across 2026-09-29T00:00Z, one alias each, a height above the tip among them
answers.query: query($h0: Int!, $h1: Int!, $h2: Int!, $h3: Int!, $h4: Int!, $h5: Int!, $h6: Int!, $h7: Int!) { b0: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h0 } }) { height time } b1: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h1 } }) { height time } b2: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h2 } }) { height time } b3: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h3 } }) { height time } b4: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h4 } }) { height time } b5: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h5 } }) { height time } b6: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h6 } }) { height time } b7: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h7 } }) { height time } }

answers.what: a page with the success and the function of each call
answers.query: query($above: Int!, $limit: Int!) { getTransactions(where: { block_height: { gt: $above }, messages: { typeUrl: { eq: "exec" } } }, order: { heightAndIndex: ASC }, limit: $limit) { block_height success messages { value { __typename ... on MsgCall { pkg_path caller func } } } } }

answers.what: the time of that page's blocks
answers.query: query($h0: Int!, $h1: Int!, $h2: Int!, $h3: Int!) { b0: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h0 } }) { height time } b1: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h1 } }) { height time } b2: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h2 } }) { height time } b3: getBlocks(where: { height: { eq: $h3 } }) { height time } }
